long_biography.plain_text:
Investor Henrik Persson Ekdahl was trading used cars before he had a driving licence. He bought cars advertised on teletext and offered them to a wider audience through newspapers and emerging online platforms. His father ran a tyre workshop with two brothers, and Ekdahl later sold watches while studying in England to avoid student debt.

He created a mentorship scholarship for student entrepreneurs in Kristianstad. Winning teams spend a week in South Africa working with him and his business network, with travel and accommodation included. The visit gives students time to develop their business ideas and plans, receiving advice and analysis directly from Ekdahl.
